gen-gf-bellota-gf-rokkitt: Rokkitt has a bookish, traditional look, its c opened wide like a bent paperclip. Rokkitt, a text serif, would carry a long passage with a sturdy, old-fashioned warmth, while Bellota's tubelike lines stay up top.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-sanchez: Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine, every stroke traced like cable bent into shapes. Sanchez answers with dignity: a serif whose c opens like calipers, giving the pair its strongest quality, a bookish gravity.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-solway: Solway reads with authority, its line weight flat as a sign-painter's stencil and its e generously open. Solway, a text serif, sits under Bellota's display heading like a steady hand beneath a showy flourish.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-yuji-boku: Dignified and editorial, Yuji Boku holds every stroke to one thickness. Bellota, the display heading, traces its lines the same way, so the two feel drawn by one hand, though Yuji Boku's wide-open c breathes more.
gen-gf-bellota-nunito-sans: Soft, open-mouthed curves fill Nunito Sans, while Bellota's spaghetti-like strokes keep the same width from end to end. Side by side, one feels like a friendly murmur and the other a confident call.
gen-gf-bellota-text-dm-sans: DM Sans is friendly and approachable, with wide-set terminals on its s and a low-key manner throughout. Bellota Text, drawn in one unchanging line weight even in its g, leads with more swagger.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-paquito: Paquito reads confident and approachable, its lowercase standing close to the caps. Bellota Text keeps bold-looking and light-looking strokes from ever mixing in a word, so the serif below seems taller and more settled by comparison.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-aleo: Dignified and classic, Aleo lets the eye slip in and out of its counters with ease. Bellota Text, with its monoweight skeleton, would hand over to this text serif without a snag.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-almendra-sc: Stout, stately, and a bit storybook. Bellota Text makes every diagonal as heavy as every upright, and Almendra SC, a serif with mouths open on c, e, and a, adds an authoritative, dignified voice beneath.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-antic-slab: Antic Slab reads dignified and editorial, its round bowls never swelling or tapering and its s curves barely curled in. Bellota Text commands attention up top, while this text serif does the quiet work.
